name: The Klingon Civil War
blurb: Winter 2367. The Chancellor is dead and the High Council is split. On turn 4 the House of Duras takes a share of the Empire's worlds and ships and raises its banner; the Romulans fund the rebels. You are the loyalist Klingon Empire. Federation, Romulans and Cardassians watch the war.
briefing: The Empire is about to split. A rival house will rise on turn 4 and take the worlds farthest from Qo'noS.
The Romulans will back the House of Duras with an alliance.
Win by breaking the House of Duras, or by keeping a colony to turn 90.

triggers.text: The High Council has split: the House of Duras has raised its banner against the Empire.
Romulan agents fund the House of Duras; the Romulan Star Empire declares itself its ally.
Qo'noS has fallen. The Empire's heart is in rebel hands.

victory.name: The House of Duras broken
victory.text: The rebel house has no world left and the Empire is whole again.

victory.name: The Empire endures
victory.text: The Empire outlasted the civil war.
